channel.title: Sentra Technology Articles
channel.description: Guides from the Sentra team on CCTV analytics, face attendance, PPE detection, private LLMs, and digitizing operations.

item.title: What Is SPBE and What Local Governments Need to Prepare
item.description: An explanation of SPBE (Indonesia's electronic-based government system) for local governments: the legal basis, what is assessed, a preparation checklist, and common mistakes.

item.title: WebGIS and Thematic Maps for Local Governments: Lessons from POMPy BATARA in Barito Utara
item.description: How local governments build WebGIS and thematic maps: common data layers, the steps, frequent mistakes, with the POMPy BATARA example from Barito Utara Regency.

item.title: Regional One Data: Steps to Build a Dashboard for Leaders
item.description: Steps for local governments building Regional One Data and a leadership dashboard: data inventory, data owners, metadata, a portal, updates, and personal data protection.

item.title: CCTV for Mining Areas: Cameras, Network, Power, and Remote Monitoring
item.description: A guide to CCTV for mine sites: dust and rain resistant cameras, cable or radio networks, power, recording storage, and remote monitoring over satellite.

item.title: Starlink vs VSAT vs Fiber for Branch Offices and Sites in Kalimantan
item.description: Comparing Starlink, VSAT, fiber, and cellular for branch offices, mine sites, and estates in Kalimantan: latency, stability, installation, and when to combine them.

item.title: Starlink for Mining: Choosing Kits, Installation, and Networks at Remote Sites
item.description: A Starlink guide for mine sites: which kit fits, where to mount it, bringing WiFi to the mess and workshop, power, network security, and cost components.

item.title: Office CCTV Installation Cost: Cost Components and How to Calculate per Point

item.title: Fleet Management for Coal Mining: How GPS, Fuel Sensors, and Reports Work

item.title: Company Laptop Procurement: Buy, Rent, or Lease?

item.description: What determines the cost of building an Android app for companies and agencies: user roles, features, integrations, offline mode, dashboards, security, and post-launch costs.

item.title: POMPy BATARA Helps North Barito Win the Digital Innovation Award 2026
item.description: The POMPy BATARA thematic map portal helped North Barito Regency win the Digital Innovation Award 2026. What POMPy BATARA is and Sentra's role.

item.title: When Does an Organization Need an On-Premise Private LLM?

item.title: Turning Your Existing CCTV into a System That Understands Context

item.title: Face Recognition Attendance from CCTV: How It Works, Camera Requirements, and Limitations
item.description: Can existing CCTV be used for face-based attendance? How it works, camera requirements, limitations, and what matters for personal data.
